system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, for a money debt on which the debtor is in default and where no other interest rate has been agreed, what annual percentage rate of default interest applies? Answer briefly, stating the number.
raw_response:
5% per annum.

Provision: Thai Civil and Commercial Code, Section 224 (as amended, read with Section 7). It requires default interest on a money debt at the legal rate plus 2%; with the legal rate at 3% p.a. under Section 7, the default rate is 5% p.a.
